MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 18

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 28

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
